title: Dual numbers over a ring
statement: For a commutative ring $R$, the ring of dual numbers $R[\epsilon]$ is Mathlib's `DualNumber R`, with distinguished element $\epsilon=\operatorname{DualNumber.eps}$ satisfying $\epsilon^2=0$ [def-pc-scheme].
